For the Appellant(s) : Mr. Shekhar Siddharth, Advocate For the State(s) : Mr. Vijay Kumar Sinha, Advocate For the Informant : None  --------
Order No. 03: Dated: 16th February, 2024
No one appears for the informant despite of service of notice.
Heard the learned counsel for the appellant and the learned counsel for the State.

This petitioner is arrested in connection with SC/ST Case No. 08 of 2023 (Chiniya P.S. Case No. 15 of 2023) for offence punishable under sections 376, 458 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3(2)(v) of the SC/ST (POA) Act.
The prayer for regular bail of this petitioner was rejected which led to filing of this appeal.
The allegation against the petitioner is that at the night about 10 p.m. he went to the house of this informant and asked for drinking water.

The informant opened the door and gave him water, but this petitioner entered the house and it is alleged that he entered in the bedroom and thereafter committed rape and at that time no member was present in the house.
In the FIR it was mentioned that on the next day the prosecutrix informed about the incident to her father.

After going through the case diary and material on record, I find that there are statement of the witnesses who stated that villagers caught the informant at the night itself in front of the house of the respondents.
Further charge has been framed in this case.
The appellant is in custody since 13.03.2023.
Further in the statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. victim stated that the family members of the victim also caught hold both of them and taken them to police Station.

sentences.text: Considering the nature of allegation and the period of custody, I am inclined to allow the appeal.

The appellant is directed to be released on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousands Only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Special Judge, SC/ST Act-cum-Additonal Sessions Judge-I, Garhwa in connection with SC/ST Case No. 08 of 2023 (Chiniya P.S. Case No. 15 of 2023).
The order dated 14.06.2023 passed by the learned Special Judge, SC/ST Act-cum-Additional Sessions Judge-I, Garhwa is set aside.
Accordingly, this appeal is allowed.

(ANANDA SEN, J.) MM Nitish Gupta @ Nitish Kumar Gupta vs The State Of Jharkhand on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/98513999/
